title: P20 self-score 22/24 was 3 points too high: two records and several sentences said what the plan intended, not what was done (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q6, Q7)
what_went_wrong: Q1: the P19 QMS amendment and P19 addendum 10 said P20 made the retrace repeatable and committed the full run; the 15 traces were withdrawn and the committed run prints UNTRACED: 44.
Q2: copy_log.txt header named a capture that was not final and said all later commands were reads.
Q3: R5 section 32 said every file was run once on unfrozen bytes; about 17 of 39 were, and p13_wide_sample.sh never.
Q6/Q7: 'one canned log per pattern' (the first log holds two); hang root cause stated although the same record says it is not established.
root_cause: Same as P15-P19: sentences were written from the plan before the plan changed (the trace withdrawal) and were not re-read afterwards.
detection: Independent local review of P20 (19/24, docs/khanza_r5_p20_review.md); each finding opened in the file before P21 changed it.
impact: Records that Astra v13 would have read; no tool byte or box state changed.

correction.applied: P21 (R5 section 33): lines struck or corrected; after each edit the changed lines were reopened and compared with the data.

rule: After a plan changes mid-wave, every record line written before the change that contains copied, committed, repeatable, every, all, final or only is reopened against the data before the commit.
